title: Lab 4 Phase 2: populated migration, Actions data and idempotent seeds
scope: Add approved Action/history/version/idempotency data, indexes and known resolution timestamp. Preserve nine baseline models and seven migrations. Test populated legacy migration, before/after identities and relationships, isolated backup/restore recovery and repeated seeds. Cover all Ticket states/priorities/ownership and zero/one/multiple Actions. No production reset.

title: Lab 4 Phase 3: Actions API, authorization, history and concurrency
scope: Implement create/list/edit/assign/transition/event APIs against contract. Enforce actor identity, active assignee, owned read-only Requester access, terminal restrictions, conditional validation, immutable events, parent-version serialization and persistent retry keys. Retain failing then passing tests and real negative API/DB proofs.

title: Lab 4 Phase 4: Actions Taken UI and role-safe work history
scope: Extend Ticket Detail with Action list/create/view/edit/assign/complete/cancel and work history. Demonstrate different Staff work on same Ticket. Requester read-only. Retain input/idempotency key on recoverable failures; reconcile conflicts. Capture fully loaded validation, inactive-assignee, safe-failure and three-viewport evidence with component/E2E tests.

title: Lab 4 Phase 5: final Ticket transitions and resolution gate
scope: Enforce exact Ticket matrix, completed-work/no-open-work/no-follow-up Resolve gate, advisory Requester indication, audited ordered history, safe terminal/legacy behavior and concurrency. Test every enum pair, direct bypass and races with Action creation/follow-up changes. Capture Resolve/Close/Reopen/Cancel proof and role visibility.

title: Lab 4 Phase 6: authoritative role dashboards and drill-down
scope: Implement owned Requester and Staff/Admin concise metrics, current-user performedBy Actions, recent/attention/urgent lists and identical drill-down filters. Verify counts against real fixture DB queries, Bangkok calendar boundaries and unknown legacy resolution times. Capture loading/zero/forbidden/failure and all three viewports.

title: Lab 4 Phase 7: full regression, accessibility and final hardening
acs: All ACs; especially AC-09 through AC-13
scope: Run full Labs 1-3 and Lab 4 unit/API/UI/auth/workflow/E2E regressions and builds; migration/recovery, retries/security and documented performance smoke. Inspect every major screen desktop/tablet/mobile and keyboard/semantics/contrast/clipping/overlap/overflow. Update README and evidence matrix; no unfinished controls, skipped required proof or invented Pass.

title: Lab 4 Phase 8: reviewed release, final-main evidence and submission
acs: Product DoD and all nine report Parts
scope: Maintain real reviewer comments/replies/approval/merge records and authentic 6-10 AI prompts with student-confirmed reflection. Reviewer-merge release lab4-staging into main; run complete final-main verification and capture all-Done board. Produce one concise nine-Part PDF with working links, readable evidence, page-numbered clickable contents and every-page QA; no browser print headers.
